aria_snapshot:
- main:
  - paragraph: Draft ERC · research snapshot 2026-09-28
  - heading "The NFT becomes its own machine-readable profile." [level=1]
  - paragraph: "ERC-8048 is a tiny onchain key–value interface with a large agentic ambition: put an agent’s context, endpoints and cross-chain accounts inside its token—without replacing ERC-8004’s trust machinery."
  - link "Start with the verdict ↓":
    - /url: "#verdict"
  - link "Open official spec ↗":
    - /url: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8048
  - text: "TOKEN REGISTRY / ONCHAIN READ #667 ERC-721 agent token context → “I verify before I believe…” endpoint[mcp] → protocol URI address[chain-id] → 20-byte account account[chain-id][0] → token-bound account 8048"
  - navigation "Page sections":
    - link "Verdict":
      - /url: "#verdict"
    - link "Primitive":
      - /url: "#primitive"
    - link "8048 vs 8004":
      - /url: "#comparison"
    - link "Why it matters":
      - /url: "#why"
    - link "Timeline":
      - /url: "#timeline"
    - link "Risks":
      - /url: "#risks"
    - link "Ecosystem":
      - /url: "#ecosystem"
    - link "Your move":
      - /url: "#move"
    - text: 8 min read
  - complementary "Research confidence":
    - strong: Signal, not consensus.
    - paragraph: The core spec is concrete. Adoption is not. Most implementation evidence is still testnet, roadmap or anecdotal.
    - text: SPEC STATUS ADOPTION MAINNET
  - article:
    - text: 00 / THE READ
    - heading "Watch closely. Pilot cheaply. Don’t migrate." [level=2]
    - text: →
    - heading "ERC-8048 is a metadata add-on, not a new identity." [level=3]
    - paragraph: Keep ERC-8004 as the canonical identity and trust rail. Mirror useful agent profile fields into ERC-8048 only when your NFT contract—or a sidecar—can support it cheaply. The technology is coherent; the ecosystem commitment is not yet proven.
    - text: 01 / THE PRIMITIVE
    - heading "One read function. Arbitrary bytes. Auditable writes." [level=2]
    - paragraph:
      - text: The official Draft standard extends ERC-721, ERC-1155 or ERC-6909 token registries with a generic key–value lookup. It requires EIP-165, EIP-7930 and EIP-8119. The getter’s ERC-165 interface ID is
      - code: "0xdf670be1"
      - text: .
    - text: IERC8048Metadata.sol
    - button "COPY"
    - text: function metadata(uint256 tokenId, string calldata key) external view returns (bytes memory); event MetadataSet( uint256 indexed tokenId, string indexed indexedKey, string key, bytes value ); // Optional; write policy is set by the contract. function setMetadata( uint256 tokenId, string calldata key, bytes calldata value ) external; ERC-721T PROFILE
    - heading "Reserved agent keys" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - code: context
      - text: ","
      - code: endpoint[mcp|a2a|web|x402]
      - text: ","
      - code: address[chain-id]
      - text: ", and optional additional"
      - code: account[…][index]
      - text: entries. It is a convention inside the spec, not a separate interface ID.
    - text: TOKENURI UNCHANGED
    - heading "Wallet-safe adoption" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - text: Marketplaces continue reading familiar visual metadata. Agent-aware clients call
      - code: metadata()
      - text: for operational fields; older clients simply ignore them.
    - text: OPTIONAL AUTHORITY
    - heading "Writes need not follow ownership" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - code: IERC8048MetadataAuthority
      - text: can assign field governance to a separate authority. Its interface ID is
      - code: "0xf9cb127d"
      - text: .
    - text: SIDECAR PATH
    - heading "Existing collections can join" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - text: A top-level
      - code: metadata_contract
      - text: field in token JSON may point to an external contract implementing the getter—an adoption path added after Normies NFT feedback.
    - paragraph:
      - text: "Fact source: official ERC-8048 specification. The spec itself warns clients to treat"
      - code: context
      - text: and endpoint values as untrusted input.
    - text: 02 / THE STACK
    - heading "8048 stores. 8004 establishes trust." [level=2]
    - paragraph: They are deliberately orthogonal, but their edges overlap enough to create real fragmentation risk.
    - text: ERC-8004
    - heading "Identity + trust" [level=3]
    - list:
      - listitem: Identity, reputation and validation registries
      - listitem: Profile via a URI-addressed registration file
      - listitem:
        - text: Optional onchain
        - code: getMetadata
        - text: /
        - code: setMetadata
      - listitem: The ecosystem’s current identity rail
    - text: STACK ERC-8048 / 721T
    - heading "Metadata + discovery" [level=3]
    - list:
      - listitem: Generic token-level key–value storage
      - listitem: Context, service endpoints and accounts onchain
      - listitem: No reputation or validation mechanism
      - listitem: Can attach directly to an existing NFT
    - strong: "The collision:"
    - text: ERC-8004 already exposes
    - code: getMetadata()
    - text: ; ERC-8048 standardizes
    - code: metadata()
    - text: . Both are Draft, both use similarly shaped
    - code: MetadataSet
    - text: events, and no published convergence path exists. 03 / THE “FUTURE” CASE
    - heading "Why the idea is bigger than its interface." [level=2]
    - paragraph: "This section is synthesis, not settled fact: it explains the strongest case behind the “future” claim."
    - heading "Zero-pin profiles" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Descriptions, endpoints and accounts can be read through RPC without depending on an IPFS pin, HTTPS host or gateway.
    - heading "NFT-native agents" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - text: An ordinary collection can gain machine-readable behavior while retaining its existing marketplace-facing
      - code: tokenURI
      - text: .
    - heading "Payment-ready discovery" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - text: Reserved
      - code: x402
      - text: endpoints and per-chain addresses turn a token into a discoverable service and account map.
    - heading "Cross-chain proofs" [level=3]
    - paragraph: The optional Diamond Storage layout creates predictable slots intended to support storage-inclusion proofs.
    - heading "Governed metadata" [level=3]
    - paragraph: A metadata authority can manage regulated or curated fields without becoming the NFT owner.
    - text: 04 / TIMELINE
    - heading "A young standard, still moving." [level=2]
    - text: 2025 AUG 13
    - heading "ERC-8004 created" [level=3]
    - paragraph: The trustless-agent identity, reputation and validation proposal arrives first.
    - text: 2025 SEP 30
    - heading "ERC-8048 created" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Prem Makeig and Rafael Abuawad define onchain metadata for token registries after the primitive splits from ERC-8041.
    - text: 2025 OCT 15
    - heading "Standalone discussion opens" [level=3]
    - paragraph: The Ethereum Magicians thread begins; naming, event design and key enumeration become early points of debate.
    - text: 2026 APR 15
    - heading "Agent profile examples land" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - code: context
      - text: and protocol endpoint patterns are added to the examples section.
    - text: 2026 APR 28
    - heading "Sidecar path added" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - text: The
      - code: metadata_contract
      - text: extension answers an adoption request from the already-deployed Normies NFT project.
    - text: 2026 SEP
    - heading "Still Draft" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Census v7 combines 8004 and 8048 on Sepolia; Helixa describes 8048 ingestion in a roadmap spec. No authoritative live-mainnet registry was found.
    - text: 05 / FRICTION
    - heading "The unresolved parts matter." [level=2]
    - text: DESIGN
    - heading "Scope creep" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Discussion participants challenged the extensions as too opinionated. The author agreed some could eventually split into separate ERCs.
    - text: GAS
    - heading "Dual-key event" [level=3]
    - paragraph: The event emits a hashed indexed key and the plaintext key. A co-author called that redundant; the author defended plaintext discovery.
    - text: INDEXING
    - heading "No key enumeration" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - text: There is no core
      - code: keys()
      - text: . Clients must know keys in advance or index historical events.
    - text: ECOSYSTEM
    - heading "Competing surfaces" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - code: metadata()
      - text: and ERC-8004’s
      - code: getMetadata()
      - text: may leave implementers supporting two similar Draft interfaces.
    - text: SECURITY
    - heading "Untrusted values" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Onchain does not mean safe. Context strings and endpoint URIs can still carry malicious or misleading payloads.
    - text: TRACTION
    - heading "Thin evidence" [level=3]
    - paragraph: The main discussion had roughly 14 posts over about a year; verified usage is dominated by testnet and roadmap signals.
    - text: 06 / WHO IS TOUCHING IT
    - heading "Early stack signals, not mass adoption." [level=2]
    - text: Helixa CONFIRMED PLAN
    - paragraph: The Multipass roadmap treats ERC-8004 as the identity rail and ERC-8048/721T as an NFT metadata fragment to ingest—not the whole identity system.
    - text: Census v7 SEPOLIA
    - paragraph: Its published pipeline notes say the release implements ERC-8004 + ERC-8048 + ERC-8217 + ERC-2981 together.
    - text: Normies NFT PLANNED
    - paragraph:
      - text: The team requested the external
      - code: metadata_contract
      - text: adoption path in the standards discussion.
    - text: DePunks / StonkBrokers ANECDOTAL
    - paragraph: Author-side social posts claim ERC-721T use with ERC-6551 accounts; no authoritative usage registry was found.
    - text: Virtuals NO LINK FOUND
    - paragraph: No research source connected Virtuals Protocol to ERC-8048.
    - text: 07 / PRACTICAL MOVE
    - heading "Duplicate the profile. Preserve the identity." [level=2]
    - paragraph: "Opinionated recommendation for an already ERC-8004-registered agent:"
    - text: NOW
    - heading "Keep 8004 canonical" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Do not abandon its identity, reputation or validation rails. ERC-8048 cannot replace those layers.
    - text: PILOT
    - heading "Mirror a small key set" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Use an upgradeable agent NFT or the sidecar pattern. Start with context, web/MCP endpoints and the relevant chain address.
    - text: ESCALATE WHEN
    - heading "Readers appear" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - text: Adopt broadly after Review/Final status, multiple indexers query
      - code: "0xdf670be1"
      - text: ", or counterparties ask for it directly."
    - heading "Open questions before committing gas" [level=3]
    - list:
      - listitem: "? No authoritative registry of ERC-8048/721T mainnet deployments or usage volumes was found."
      - listitem: "? No independent gas benchmark was found for the claimed ERC-721T cost advantage over an ERC-8004 registry."
      - listitem: "? The event-design PR outcome was not independently confirmed; the 2026-09-28 spec still showed the dual-key event."
      - listitem: "? The original “ERC-8048 is the future” X post could not be independently verified beyond the supplied mission context."
    - text: PRIMARY & SUPPORTING SOURCES
